title: Evaluating the Inclusiveness of Artificial Intelligence Software in Enhancing Project Management Efficiency – A Review
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a subject of its analysis. The focus was on general inclusivity and efficiency of AI in project management.

measurement_description: The paper did not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It proposed a methodology for measuring general inclusiveness in AI for project management, focusing on technical aspects, user interaction, ethical considerations, and organizational impact.
